CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   C. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   D. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
